name: Tarot
summary: Every slide is a tarot card: an oxblood card with a double gold border and corner fans, a Roman numeral at the top, an arched inner frame with a line-art emblem and a name plate at the bottom; the last slide is the patterned card back.

accent.use: the antique gold of all line art: the card border and corner fans, the numeral, the arch, the emblems, the plates, the star markers, the small cards of the spread, the gold action plate and *emphasis*
